@graph.description: Rhodiola rosea is a stimulating adaptogen best matched to stress-related fatigue and mental stamina, not bedtime calming. Small human trials and reviews are encouraging, but preparations and study quality vary; standardized rosavin and salidroside content, morning timing, and activation or insomnia risk are practical differentiators.
